vertical_reference: ETOPO2022 nominal EGM2008 orthometric elevation in metres;provider current depths are positive down from their own sea-surface context. No datum/tide/model-grid reconciliation recovered.
offset_interpretation: -20,0,+20m are explicit nominal surface/datum sensitivity scenarios,not uncertainty bounds or observed sea levels. Compare central bilinear lower surfaces only.
spatial_interpretation: Nearest-neighbor export at0.04degree centers is a coarse sampled screen,not complete15arcsecond terrain inspection. Thin land,shoals and between-sample conflicts may be missed. No-conflict is not validation.
